messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High external tool-call throughput detected in us-west-2 -> spikes causing 5xx on /v1/chat/completions. Alert INC12345 at 03:12 UTC
Alex (oncall): taking this. Seeing ~78% fn_call payloads. ETA 5m to propose live mitigations.
Jordan (SRE): recommend soft holdback: disable external/function calls for free/hobby and throttle structured output streaming. Want to avoid hard shutdown.
Maria (prod-eng): +1. Need quick customer impact sweep — which tenants are affected? Please tag account team.
Alex (oncall): quick plan: 
1) Apply feature gate: tool_calls.allowed_plans = ["paid","dedicated"]
2) Enforce streaming_token_limit = 1024 for chat.* routes
3) Add soft-429 on toolcall route with 10rps per-customer backoff
4) Notify customers and create status page update
I'll run commands now.
Alex (oncall): running:
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
-d '{"flag":"tool_calls.allowed_plans","value":["paid","dedicated"]}'
```
deploy-bot: rollout started for flag tool_calls.allowed_plans -> 5% canary
Jordan (SRE): Pushing traffic-shaping rule on ingress-frontend:
```
rate_limit {
  route: "/v1/chat/*/invoke"
  per_customer_qps: 10
  action: soft_429
}
```
Alex (oncall): flag canary green, rolling to 100% (applied to free/hobby). streaming_token_limit pushed as config override to runtime pool-3.
Maria (prod-eng): compiling impacted tenants: A123 (startup), B234 (mobile app), C345 (sandbox). Reaching out to AE and SE now.
Alex (oncall): monitoring metrics — error rate dropped 40%, lat p95 improved from 620ms -> 220ms. Still watching fncall queue depth.
Jordan (SRE): recommend follow-up: post-incident rollout of model-level heuristics for toolcall detection and a quota bump option for paying customers.
Maria (prod-eng): will prepare customer comms template. Also request temporary credit for affected paid customers if they hit degraded SLA.
Alex (oncall): Incident page created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-12345. Moving to incident channel and scheduling 30m postmortem.
SRE Liaison: leaving note: if any tenant needs immediate restore of tool calls, we can whitelist by tenant-id via control-plane /admin/whitelist.
Alex (oncall): closing thread, monitoring for 30m. :thumbsup:
